reviews.comment:
This prof knows how to do one thing: exploit undergrads 

His method of education is comparable to detention: you have to go 

Would not recommend

Blanton is one of the best profs I've ever had. He's a great lecturer: he actually shows some personality during lectures (dude's funny!), explains everything in his own words, and can tell when student's aren't understanding (or he at least asks). I even found the (boring?) material kind of interesting from the way he presented it. A real gem!

Love this guy. The material is BORING and can seem hard to retain at first because of a lot of information and big words. I got a C on my first test and thought I was doomed. But when I actually sat down and look at the info it was easy. And pulled out As in the next two exams. no Cumulative Final & no group project/research project. TAKE HIM.

Professor Blanton is very kind, funny, and truly cares about the success of his students. He has no Cumulative Final (just Test 3) & no group project/research project. He takes a course that probably none of us are TOO excited about taking (it's required) and makes it interesting & applicable to our lives. Good man and Aggie. Take his class.

Prof Blanton is very enthusiastic about what he teaches and really cares about keeping students interested in the material. He is extremely helpful when questions are asked and overall a great professor.

He is a great professor and makes class fun with goofy comments. The material can be hard but he post all lectures online and gives study guides. First test is the hardest. Doesn't require research project like other 308 classes

Blanton is awesome! He posts lecture powerpoints and the readings which is super helpful. He is really good at explaining the information and slowing down when he knows he's teaching complicated stuff. He cracks jokes and makes class entertaining. This class never stressed me out, but I still feel like I learned a lot! Definitely recommend.

Blanton is great. He tries to make the boring information fun and does not have any group or research projects. The information can be boring and hard to retain. I would suggest going over the powerpoints yourself afterwards. He uploads all lectures onto ecampus.
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Blanton was great! He understands that most people taking the class aren't really going to do research so he makes it very easy to understand and only makes us learn the most important and basic parts of the material. Doesn't require a textbook, posts all readings online. Replaces lowest exam score and really wants us to succeed
He is a great Professor very nice. He gave the option to replace one of your first two exams with the final. He makes lectures interesting and he cares about his students.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read
